body_evidence.label: Hand across the body at release

explanation.basis: Compared with this athlete's 27 other analysed throws (same method version).
evidence: The carry (it landed 7 in longer than usual).
explanation.observed: Stopped on the board, 6 in long and 2 in left of the hole. First contact 7 in past the usual spot.
explanation.possible_explanation: The bag landed 7 in longer than usual, but release speed and angle did not differ beyond their noise, so the measured release does not account for it.
explanation.suggestion: Check the release frame and bag flight in the side view before drawing a conclusion.

attribution.sentence: Board: 6 in long, 2 in left. Most of the long came from the carry (it landed 7 in longer than usual). Next: throw a touch softer.
